evidence.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti? Yañca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa uttarante udakaṃ, yañca dakkhiṇante udakaṃ – ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti. Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yaṃ saddhindriyaṃ taṃ saddhābalaṃ, yaṃ saddhābalaṃ taṃ saddhindriyaṃ; yaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ taṃ vīriyabalaṃ, yaṃ vīriyabalaṃ taṃ vīriyindriyaṃ; yaṃ satindriyaṃ taṃ satibalaṃ , yaṃ satibalaṃ taṃ satindriyaṃ; yaṃ samādhindriyaṃ taṃ samādhibalaṃ, yaṃ samādhibalaṃ taṃ samādhindriyaṃ; yaṃ paññindriyaṃ taṃ paññābalaṃ, yaṃ paññābalaṃ taṃ paññindriyaṃ. Pañcannaṃ, bhikkhave, indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，是何理趣，依此理趣，那条河可计为二流呢？比丘们，那岛屿北端的水，以及南端的水——比丘们，此即是理趣，依此理趣，那条河可计为二流。同样地，比丘们，信根即是信力，信力即是信根；精进根即是精进力，精进力即是精进根；念根即是念力，念力即是念根；定根即是定力，定力即是定根；慧根即是慧力，慧力即是慧根。比丘们，比丘修习、多修习这五根，由于诸漏已尽，便能于现法中亲自证知、现证无漏的心解脱、慧解脱而住。”第三经。
evidence.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the reason by which that river comes to be reckoned as ‘two streams’? The water, bhikkhus, at the northern end of that island and the water at the southern end—this, indeed, bhikkhus, is the reason by which that river comes to be reckoned as ‘two streams’. In this very same way, bhikkhus, that which is the faculty of faith is the power of faith; that which is the power of faith is the faculty of faith. That which is the faculty of energy is the power of energy; that which is the power of energy is the faculty of energy. That which is the faculty of mindfulness is the power of mindfulness; that which is the power of mindfulness is the faculty of mindfulness. That which is the faculty of concentration is the power of concentration; that which is the power of concentration is the faculty of concentration. That which is the faculty of wisdom is the power of wisdom; that which is the power of wisdom is the faculty of wisdom. Bhikkhus, due to having developed and frequently practiced the five faculties, a bhikkhu, through the destruction of the taints, dwells having attained the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom, having realized it for himself with direct knowledge in this very life.” The third.

entries.pali: Saddhābalādīsupi saddhādīni vuttatthāneva. Akampiyaṭṭhena pana balanti veditabbaṃ. Evametesu assaddhiye na kampatīti saddhābalaṃ . Kosajje na kampatīti vīriyabalaṃ . Muṭṭhassacce na kampatīti satibalaṃ . Uddhacce na kampatīti samādhibalaṃ . Avijjāya na kampatīti paññābalaṃ . Ahirike na kampatīti hiribalaṃ . Anottappe na kampatīti ottappabala nti. Ayaṃ ubhayapadavasena atthavaṇṇanā hoti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于信力等中，信等之义亦如前说。然应知“力”以不动摇为义。如此，于此等[力]中：不为不信所动摇，故为信力；不为懈怠所动摇，故为精进力；不为失念所动摇，故为念力；不为掉举所动摇，故为定力；不为无明所动摇，故为慧力；不为无惭所动摇，故为惭力；不为无愧所动摇，故为愧力。此为依二词之义释。
entries.english: In the terms beginning with the faith-power, 'faith' and the other terms have the same meaning as already stated. However, 'power' should be understood in the sense of being unshakable. Thus, among these: it is the 'faith-power' because it is not shaken by faithlessness; it is the 'energy-power' because it is not shaken by laziness; it is the 'mindfulness-power' because it is not shaken by forgetfulness; it is the 'concentration-power' because it is not shaken by restlessness; it is the 'wisdom-power' because it is not shaken by ignorance; it is the 'moral shame-power' because it is not shaken by shamelessness; it is the 'moral dread-power' because it is not shaken by lack of moral dread. This is the explanation of the meaning by way of both terms.

entries.pali: Paññā pana indriyāni patvā paññindriyaṃ hotīti vuttā, maggaṅgāni patvā sammādiṭṭhīti, balāni patvā paññābalanti, mūlāni patvā amohoti, kammapathaṃ patvā sammādiṭṭhīti, piṭṭhidukaṃ patvā sampajaññaṃ vipassanāti. Evaṃ eko dhammo sattasu ṭhānesu vibhatto.
entries.chinese_simplified: 再者，慧至于诸根，被称为慧根；至于道支，被称为正见；至于诸力，被称为慧力；至于诸（善）根，被称为无痴；至于业道，被称为正见；至于背二法(piṭṭhiduka)，被称为正知(sampajañña)与观(vipassanā)。如是，此一法于七处被分别。
entries.english: Furthermore, wisdom, having reached the faculties, is spoken of as the 'faculty of wisdom'; having reached the path factors, as 'Right View'; having reached the powers, as the 'power of wisdom'; having reached the roots, as 'non-delusion'; having reached the courses of action, as 'Right View'; and having reached the pair of backing states, as 'clear comprehension' and 'insight'. Thus, this one state is divided into seven instances.

entries.pali: 16 . Paññindriyaniddese tassa tassa atthassa pākaṭakaraṇasaṅkhātena paññāpanaṭṭhena paññā . Tena tena vā aniccādinā pakārena dhamme jānātītipi paññā. Idamassā sabhāvapadaṃ. Pajānanākāro pajānanā . Aniccādīni vicinātīti vicayo. Pavicayo ti upasaggena padaṃ vaḍḍhitaṃ . Catusaccadhamme vicinātīti dhammavicayo . Aniccādīnaṃ sallakkhaṇavasena sallakkhaṇā . Sāyeva puna upasagganānattena upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā ti vuttā. Paṇḍitassa bhāvo paṇḍiccaṃ . Kusalassa bhāvo kosallaṃ . Nipuṇassa bhāvo nepuññaṃ . Aniccādīnaṃ vibhāvanavasena vebhabyā . Aniccādīnaṃ cintanakavasena cintā . Yassa vā uppajjati taṃ aniccādīni cintāpetītipi cintā. Aniccādīni upaparikkhatīti upaparikkhā. Bhūrī ti pathaviyā nāmaṃ. Ayampi saṇhaṭṭhena vitthaṭaṭṭhena ca bhūrī viyāti bhūrī . Tena vuttaṃ – ‘‘bhūrī vuccati pathavī . Tāya pathavīsamāya vitthaṭāya vipulāya paññāya samannāgatoti bhūripaññoti (mahāni. 27). Apica paññāya etaṃ adhivacanaṃ bhūrī’’ti. Bhūte atthe ramatītipi bhūrī. Asani viya siluccaye kilese medhati hiṃsatīti medhā . Khippaṃ gahaṇadhāraṇaṭṭhena vā medhā . Yassa uppajjati taṃ attahitapaṭipattiyaṃ sampayuttadhamme ca yāthāvalakkhaṇapaṭivedhe parinetīti pariṇāyikā . Aniccādivasena dhamme vipassatīti vipassanā . Sammā pakārehi aniccādīni jānātīti sampajaññaṃ . Uppathapaṭipanne sindhave vīthiāropanatthaṃ patodo viya uppathe dhāvanakaṃ kūṭacittaṃ vīthiāropanatthaṃ vijjhatīti patodo viya patodo . Dassanalakkhaṇe indaṭṭhaṃ kāretīti indriyaṃ. Paññāsaṅkhātaṃ indriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ . Avijjāya na kampatīti paññābalaṃ . Kilesacchedanaṭṭhena paññāva satthaṃ paññāsatthaṃ . Accuggataṭṭhena paññāva pāsādo paññāpāsādo .
entries.chinese_simplified: 16. 在慧根的解释中，以其能阐明种种义理，故称为慧（paññā）；或以种种方式了知诸法为无常等，故为慧。此为它的自性语。了知之相即是了知。审察无常等，故为择。加上前缀，则成遍择。审察四圣谛法，故为择法。以辨识无常等之相，故为识知。此亦因前缀不同，而被称为随识知与对识知。智者之状态为睿智。善巧之状态为善巧性。敏锐之状态为敏锐性。以辨别无常等，故为辨别。以思惟无常等，故为思；或它生起时，能令其人思惟无常等，故亦为思。审度无常等，故为审度。大地名为‘广’。此慧亦如大地般，因其精细与广阔，故为‘广’。因此说：‘广，即是大地。具足如大地般广阔、博大之慧，故为广慧者。’再者，‘广’是慧的同义词。乐于真实义，故亦为‘广’。如雷电摧毁石山般摧毁烦恼，故为捷慧；或以快速把握、忆持之义，故为捷慧。它生起时，能引导其人于自利之行与相应之法，以及如实了悟其特征，故为引导者。以无常等方式观见诸法，故为观（vipassanā）。正确地了知无常等，故为正知。如刺棒之于走上歧途的马匹，能令其回归正道；同样，它刺向走上歧途的欺诈心，令其回归正道，故如刺棒，名为刺棒。于见之相中行使主导作用，故为根。慧即是根，故为慧根。不为无明所动摇，故为慧力。以斩断烦恼之义，慧即是剑，故为慧剑。以高耸之义，慧即是宫殿，故为慧殿。
entries.english: 16. In the exposition of the faculty of wisdom, 'wisdom' (paññā) is so called because of the meaning of making clear, designated as the state of making manifest the meaning of this or that. Or, it is also 'wisdom' (paññā) because it knows phenomena in this or that way, such as impermanence. This is the term for its intrinsic nature. The mode of discerning is 'discernment' (pajānanā). It investigates things such as impermanence, hence it is called 'investigation' (vicayo). As ‘pavicayo,’ the term is augmented with a prefix. It investigates the four noble truths, hence it is called 'investigation of phenomena' (dhammavicayo). By means of correctly marking things such as impermanence, it is 'correct marking' (sallakkhaṇā). The same, due to the variation of prefixes, is taught as 'marking' (upalakkhaṇā) and 'remarking' (paccupalakkhaṇā). The state of a wise person is 'sagacity' (paṇḍiccaṃ). The state of a skillful person is 'skillfulness' (kosallaṃ). The state of a refined person is 'refinement' (nepuññaṃ). By means of analyzing things such as impermanence, it is 'analysis' (vebhabyā). By means of thinking about things such as impermanence, it is 'thought' (cintā). Or, when it arises in a person, it causes that person to think about things such as impermanence, hence it is also 'thought' (cintā). It closely examines things such as impermanence, hence it is 'close examination' (upaparikkhā). ‘Bhūrī’ is a name for the earth. This wisdom is also ‘bhūrī’ because, like the earth, it is subtle and extensive. Therefore it is said: ‘“Bhūrī” is said of the earth. One who is endowed with wisdom that is extensive and vast like that earth is called “one of vast wisdom” (bhūripañño). Moreover, “bhūrī” is a designation for wisdom.’ It is also ‘bhūrī’ because it delights in the true meaning. Like a thunderbolt on a heap of rock, it strikes and destroys defilements, hence it is ‘intelligence’ (medhā). Or, because of its meaning of quick grasping and retention, it is ‘medhā.’ When it arises in a person, it guides that person in the practice for their own welfare and in the penetration of the true characteristics of associated states, hence it is the 'guide' (pariṇāyikā). It sees phenomena by way of impermanence, etc., hence it is 'insight' (vipassanā). It knows things such as impermanence correctly and in various ways, hence it is 'clear comprehension' (sampajaññaṃ). Like a goad for piercing a thoroughbred horse that has gone astray from the path to put it back on the road, it is a 'goad' (patodo) for piercing the deceitful mind that runs astray on the wrong path to put it on the road. It exercises sovereignty in the characteristic of seeing, hence it is a 'faculty' (indriya). The faculty designated as wisdom is the 'faculty of wisdom' (paññindriya). It is not shaken by ignorance, hence it is the 'power of wisdom' (paññābala). Because of its meaning of cutting off defilements, wisdom itself is a sword, the 'sword of wisdom' (paññāsatthaṃ). Because of its meaning of being exceedingly lofty, wisdom itself is a palace, the 'palace of wisdom' (paññāpāsādo).

entries.pali: Yato kho ti ettha to -saddo dā-saddo viya kālavacano ‘‘yato kho, sāriputta, bhikkhusaṅgho’’tiādīsu (pārā. 21) viyāti vuttaṃ ‘‘yadā kho’’ ti. Aggahetvā ti kañcipi saṅkhāraṃ ‘‘etaṃ mamā’’tiādinā aggahetvā. Paññāvimutto ti aṭṭhannaṃ vimokkhānaṃ anadhigatattā sātisayassa samādhibalassa abhāvato paññābaleneva vimutto. Tenāha ‘‘aṭṭha vimokkhe asacchikatvā paññābalenevā’’ tiādi. Appavatti nti āyatiṃ appavattiṃ katvā. Pajānanto vimuttoti vā paññāvimutto, paṭhamajjhānaphassena vinā parijānanādippakārehi cattāri saccāni jānanto paṭivijjhanto tesaṃ kiccānaṃ matthakappattiyā niṭṭhitakiccatāya visesena muttoti vimutto. So paññāvimutto. Sukkhavipassako ti samathabhāvanāsinehābhāvena sukkhā lūkhā, asiniddhā vā vipassanā etassāti sukkhavipassako. Ṭhatvā ti pādakakaraṇavasena ṭhatvā. Aññatarasmi nti ca aññataraaññatarasmiṃ, ekekasminti attho. Evañhissa pañcavidhatā siyā. ‘‘Na heva kho aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharatī’’ti iminā sātisayassa samādhibalassa abhāvo dīpito. ‘‘Paññāya cassa disvā’’tiādinā sātisayassa paññābalassa bhāvo. Paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā hontī ti na āsavā paññāya passanti, dassanakāraṇā pana parikkhīṇā ‘‘disvā parikkhīṇā’’ti vuttā. Dassanāyattaparikkhayattā eva hi dassanaṃ āsavānaṃ khayassa purimakiriyā hoti.
entries.chinese_simplified: “从何时起”(yato kho)此处“to”字如同“dā”字般表示时间关系，如在“从何时起，舍利弗，比丘僧团”(yato kho, sāriputta, bhikkhusaṅgho)等(Pārā. 21)中所说，故说“当其时”(yadā kho)。不执取(aggahetvā)，即对任何行(saṅkhāra)不生起“这是我的”等执著。慧解脱(paññāvimutta)，因为没有证得八解脱(aṭṭha vimokkha)，缺乏殊胜的定力(samādhibala)，只是凭借智慧(paññā)的力量而解脱。因此说“没有亲身证得八解脱，只是凭借智慧的力量”等。不再生起(appavatti)，指让未来不再生起。正知解脱(pajānanto vimutto)，也可以说是慧解脱，指不通过初禅(paṭhamajjhāna)的触(phassa)等，而是通过遍知等方式，了知、通达四圣谛(cattāri sacca)；由于其应做之事已达究竟，已完成其任务，故特别地解脱，这即是慧解脱。干观者(sukkhavipassaka)，因为缺乏止禅修习(samatha-bhāvanā)的滋润(sineha)，他的观(vipassanā)是干枯、粗糙或不润泽的，所以叫做干观者。站立(ṭhatvā)，指以之为基础而住立。在某一处(aññatarasmiṃ)，指在任何一处，或每一处的意思。这样一来，它可能有五种含义。“他并非以身体触证八解脱而住”(Na heva kho aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati)这句话，说明了他缺乏殊胜的定力。“他以智慧见”(Paññāya cassa disvā)等这句话，则说明了他具有殊胜的智慧力量。“他以智慧见，诸漏(āsava)即已灭尽”(Paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti)，并非诸漏被智慧所见，而是因为见(dassana)这个原因，诸漏才得以灭尽，所以说“见而灭尽”(disvā parikkhīṇā)。实际上，诸漏的灭尽正是依赖于见，而见是诸漏灭尽的先行条件。
entries.english: Here, in `yato kho`, the sound `to` is a temporal word like the sound `dā` (as in `yadā`), as in ‘When, Sāriputta, the community of monks...’ (Pārā. 21); thus it is said to mean ‘when indeed’ (yadā kho). By ‘not having grasped’ (aggahetvā) is meant not having grasped any formation with the thought, ‘This is mine,’ and so on. “Wisdom-liberated” (paññāvimutto) means that, due to not having attained the eight liberations and due to the absence of superior power of concentration, he is liberated solely by the power of wisdom. Therefore, it is said, “not having realized the eight liberations... by the power of wisdom alone,” and so on. By ‘non-occurrence’ (appavattiṃ) is meant having brought about non-occurrence in the future. Or, `paññāvimutto` means one who is liberated while understanding (`pajānanto vimutto`); that is, knowing and penetrating the four truths through such means as full understanding, etc., without the contact of the first jhāna, he is especially liberated by the completion of the task through reaching the culmination of their functions. He is wisdom-liberated. A dry-insight practitioner (sukkhavipassako) is one whose insight is dry (sukkhā), rough (lūkhā), or unmoistened (asiniddhā) due to the absence of the moisture of serenity meditation. By ‘standing’ (ṭhatvā) is meant standing by way of making it a foundation. And ‘in any one’ (aññatarasmiṃ) means in one or another, that is, in each individual one. Thus, it may be fivefold. By “Indeed, he does not dwell having contacted the eight liberations with the body,” the absence of superior power of concentration is shown. By “and for him, having seen with wisdom,” the presence of superior power of wisdom is shown. When it is said, “and for him, having seen with wisdom, the taints are destroyed,” it is not that the taints see with wisdom; rather, because they are destroyed for the reason of seeing, it is said they are “destroyed having seen.” For it is because their destruction is dependent on seeing that seeing is the preliminary action for the destruction of the taints.

entries.pali: Kururaṭṭhaṃ kira tadā taṃnivāsisattānaṃ yonisomanasikāravantatādinā yebhuyyena suppaṭipannatāya, pubbe ca katapuññatābalena tadā utuādisampattiyuttameva ahosi. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘utupaccayādisampannattā’’ ti. Ādi -saddena bhojanādisampattiṃ saṅgaṇhāti. Keci pana ‘‘pubbe pavattakuruvattadhammānuṭṭhānavāsanāya uttarakuru viya yebhuyyena utuādisampannameva hontaṃ bhagavato kāle sātisayaṃ utusappāyādiyuttaṃ taṃ raṭṭhaṃ ahosī’’ti vadanti. Cittasarīrakallatāyā ti cittassa, sarīrassa ca arogatāya. Anuggahitapaññābalā ti laddhūpakārañāṇānubhāvā, anu anu vā āciṇṇapaññātejā. Ekavīsatiyā ṭhānesu ti kāyānupassanāvasena cuddasasu ṭhānesu, vedanānupassanāvasena ekasmiṃ ṭhāne, tathā cittānupassanāvasena, dhammānupassanāvasena pañcasu ṭhānesūti evaṃ ekavīsatiyā ṭhānesu. Kammaṭṭhānaṃ arahatte pakkhipitvā ti catusaccakammaṭṭhānaṃ yathā arahattaṃ pāpeti, evaṃ desanāvasena arahatte pakkhipitvā. Suvaṇṇacaṅkoṭakasuvaṇṇamañjūsāsu pakkhittāni sumanacampakādinānāpupphāni, maṇimuttādisattaratanāni ca yathā bhājanasampattiyā savisesaṃ sobhanti, kiccakarāni ca honti manuññabhāvato, evaṃ sīladassanādisampattiyā bhājanavisesabhūtāya kururaṭṭhavāsiparisāya desitā bhagavato ayaṃ desanā bhiyyoso mattāya sobhati, kiccakārī ca hotīti imamatthaṃ dasseti ‘‘yathā hi puriso’’ tiādinā. Etthā ti kururaṭṭhe.
entries.chinese_simplified: 据说，当时俱卢国(Kururaṭṭha)的住民，因其大多具有如理作意(yonisomanasikāra)等、行于善道，并以过去所造的福业之力，故当时节(utu)等资具皆悉圆满。因此说“时节、所缘等具足”。“等”字摄入饮食等资具的圆满。但有人说：“因往昔奉行俱卢法(kuruvatta)的习气，如北俱卢洲(Uttarakuru)一般，其国大多时节等具足，在世尊之时，更有超胜的时节、适宜等。”“心身堪能”(cittasarīrakallatā)即心与身的无病。 “为慧力所摄持”(anuggahitapaññābala)即获得助益的智慧之力，或是一再修习的智慧之光。“于二十一处”即：于身随观念处(kāyānupassanā)有十四处，于受随观念处(vedanānupassanā)有一处，同样于心随观念处(cittānupassanā)有一处，于法随观念处(dhammānupassanā)有五处，如是共二十一处。“将业处(kammaṭṭhāna)置于阿罗汉果中”即：如同四圣谛业处(catusaccakammaṭṭhāna)能引至阿罗汉果，如是将此业处以说法的方式置于阿罗汉果中。譬如将素馨花(sumana)、瞻波花(campaka)等种种花，以及摩尼(maṇi)、珍珠(mutta)等七宝(sattaratana)置于金匣金箧中，因容器之胜妙而更显庄严，且因其悦意而能起作用；同样地，世尊为俱卢国之众(parisā)——此具足戒、见等之殊胜容器——所说的此教法，也愈发庄严，且能成办事业。此即“譬如有人”等所开示之义。“于此”即于俱卢国。
entries.english: Indeed, at that time, the Kuru country was endowed with excellence of climate and other conditions because its inhabitants were for the most part well-practiced due to possessing wise attention and so on, and by the power of merit made in the past. Therefore, it is said, 'due to the excellence of climate and other conditions.' By the word 'and so on,' he includes the excellence of food and other necessities. Some, however, say: 'Due to the influence of the practice of the ancient Kuru observances, that country, being for the most part endowed with excellence of climate and so on like Uttarakuru, was, in the time of the Blessed One, exceptionally endowed with a suitable climate and other advantages.' 'Due to the fitness of mind and body' means due to the healthiness of mind and body. 'Supported by the power of wisdom' means having the power of knowledge that has received assistance, or the splendor of wisdom that has been repeatedly practiced. 'In twenty-one places' refers to fourteen places by way of the contemplation of the body, one place by way of the contemplation of feeling, likewise one place by way of the contemplation of mind, and five places by way of the contemplation of mental objects—thus, in twenty-one places. 'Having placed the meditation subject in arahantship' means having placed the meditation subject on the four truths in arahantship by way of teaching, in such a way that it leads to arahantship. Just as various flowers like jasmine and champak, placed in golden caskets and golden chests, and the seven kinds of jewels such as pearls and gems, shine with special brilliance due to the excellence of their containers and, being delightful, are effective, so too this teaching of the Blessed One, delivered to the assembly of the residents of the Kuru country—who were a special vessel due to their excellence in virtue, insight, and so on—shines all the more and is effective. This meaning is shown by the passage beginning, 'For just as a person...' 'Here' means in the Kuru country.

entries.pali: 106 . Kasmā bhagavā imaṃ suttamabhāsī ti asādhāraṇasamuṭṭhānaṃ pucchati, sādhāraṇaṃ pana pākaṭanti anāmaṭṭhaṃ, tena suttanikkhepo pucchitoti katvā itaro ‘‘kururaṭṭhavāsīna’’ ntiādinā aparajjhāsayoyaṃ suttanikkhepoti dasseti. Etena bāhirasamuṭṭhānaṃ vibhāvitanti daṭṭhabbaṃ. Ajjhattikaṃ pana asādhāraṇañca mūlapariyāyasuttādiṭīkāyaṃ vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ. Kururaṭṭhaṃ kira (dī. ni. ṭī. 2.373) tadā tannivāsīnaṃ sattānaṃ yebhuyyena yonisomanasikāravantatāya pubbe ca katapuññatābalena utuādisampannameva ahosi. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘utupaccayādisampannattā’’ ti. Ādi -saddena bhojanādisampattiṃ saṅgaṇhāti. Keci pana ‘‘pubbe kuruvattadhammānuṭṭhānavāsanāya uttarakuru viya yebhuyyena utuādisampannameva hontaṃ bhagavato kāle sātisayaṃ utusappāyādiyuttaṃ taṃ raṭṭhaṃ ahosī’’ti vadanti. Cittasarīrakallatāyā ti cittassa sarīrassa ca arogatāya. Anuggahitapaññābalā ti laddhupakārañāṇānubhāvā, anu anu vā āciṇṇapaññātejā. Ekavīsatiyā ṭhānesū ti kāyānupassanāvasena cuddasasuṭhānesu, vedanānupassanāvasena ekasmiṃ ṭhāne, tathā cittānupassanāvasena, dhammānupassanāvasena pañcasu ṭhānesūti evaṃ ekavīsatiyā ṭhānesu. Kammaṭṭhānaṃ arahatte pakkhipitvā ti catusaccakammaṭṭhānaṃ yathā arahattaṃ pāpeti, evaṃ desanāvasena arahatte pakkhipitvā. Suvaṇṇacaṅkoṭakasuvaṇṇamañjūsāsu pakkhittāni sumanacampakādinānāpupphāni maṇiputtādisattaratanāni ca yathā bhājanasampattiyā savisesaṃ sobhanti, kiccakarāni ca honti manuññābhāvato, evaṃ sīladassanādisampattiyā bhājanavisesabhūtāya kururaṭṭhavāsiparisāya desitā ca bhagavato ayaṃ desanā bhiyyosomattāya sobhati, kiccakārī ca hotīti imamatthaṃ dasseti ‘‘yathā hi puriso’’ tiādinā. Etthā ti kururaṭṭhe.
entries.chinese_simplified: 106. “世尊(Bhagavā)为何说此经？”这是在问不共的缘起，而共通的缘起已很明显，故未触及。因此，（发问者）是问此经的开演，另一人则以“俱卢国居民”等语，显示此经的开演是（针对）另一种根机。由此应知外在的缘起已被辨明。至于内在及不共的缘起，则当依《根本法门经义注复注》(Mūlapariyāya-sutta-ṭīkā)等中所说之理了知。据说当时俱卢国，因其居民大多具有如理作意，且凭藉过去所造的福业之力，时节等（条件）皆很圆满。故说“时节、助缘等具足”。“等”字包含饮食等资具的圆满。有人则说：“因往昔修习俱卢行法之习气，如北俱卢洲(Uttarakuru)般，在世尊时代，该国大部分时节等（条件）皆很圆满，且具有超胜的时节适宜等（特质）。”“身心健康”(Cittasarīrakallatāya)，即心与身的无病。“为（善法所）资助的慧力”(Anuggahitapaññābalāti)，即获得助益的智慧威力，或指屡屡修习的智慧之光。“于二十一处”，即：身随观十四处，受随观一处，心随观一处，法随观五处，共二十一处。“将业处置入阿罗汉果中”(Kammaṭṭhānaṃ arahatte pakkhipitvā)，即四谛业处能引至阿罗汉果，如是依说法而将其置入阿罗汉果中。譬如金匣金匮中，放置素馨花、瞻波迦(campaka)花等种种花，及摩尼珠等七宝，会因容器的精美而愈显庄严，且因其悦意而能成办（装饰等）作用；如是，世尊此法，因以戒、见等圆满而成为殊胜容器的俱卢国会众为（对象而）说，故愈加庄严，且能成办（道业）。此义即由“譬如有人”等（譬喻）所示。“于此”，指在俱卢国。
entries.english: 106. Why did the Blessed One speak this discourse? He asks about the uncommon origin; the common one, however, is evident and so not touched upon. Therefore, taking it that the placement of the discourse is being questioned, the other shows that this placement of the discourse is due to the unfailing intention of the inhabitants of Kururaṭṭha, etc. By this, it should be understood that the external origin has been explained. The internal and uncommon origin, however, should be known in the manner stated in the subcommentary on the Mūlapariyāya Sutta and others. It is said that the Kuru country, at that time, was endowed with favorable conditions, such as climate, mostly due to the inhabitants' wise attention and the power of their past merit. Therefore it is said, ‘because of being endowed with favorable climate and other conditions.’ By the word ‘etc.,’ he includes the excellence of food and other things. Some, however, say: ‘Due to the latent tendency from the past practice of the Kuruvatta Dhamma, that country, like Uttarakuru, was mostly endowed with favorable conditions such as climate, and during the time of the Blessed One, it became exceptionally endowed with a suitable climate, etc.’ ‘Due to the fitness of mind and body’ means due to the health of mind and body. ‘With the power of wisdom supported’ means having the power of knowledge that has received assistance, or the splendor of wisdom practiced again and again. ‘In twenty-one instances’ means in fourteen instances by way of the contemplation of the body, in one instance by way of the contemplation of feeling, likewise in one instance by way of the contemplation of mind, and in five instances by way of the contemplation of mental objects—thus, in twenty-one instances. ‘Having placed the meditation subject in Arahantship’ means having placed the meditation subject on the four truths in Arahantship by way of teaching, so that it leads to Arahantship. Just as various flowers like jasmine and campaka, and the seven precious gems, when placed in golden caskets and golden chests, shine with special brilliance due to the excellence of their containers, and are effective because they are pleasing, so too this teaching of the Blessed One, when taught to the assembly of the inhabitants of Kururaṭṭha, who are a special kind of container due to their endowment with virtue and insight, shines even more brilliantly and is effective. This meaning is shown by the passage, ‘Just as a person…,’ etc. ‘Here’ means in the Kuru country.

entries.pali: 19 . Nava balāni – saddhābalaṃ vīriyabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ paññābalaṃ hiribalaṃ ottappabalaṃ ahirikabalaṃ anottappabalaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 19. 九力(bala)：信力(saddhābala)、精进力(vīriyabala)、念力(satibala)、定力(samādhibala)、慧力(paññābala)、惭力(hiribala)、愧力(ottappabala)、无惭力(ahirikabala)、无愧力(anottappabala)。
entries.english: 19. Nine powers: the power of faith, the power of energy, the power of mindfulness, the power of concentration, the power of wisdom, the power of moral shame, the power of moral dread, the power of shamelessness, and the power of fearlessness of wrongdoing.

entries.pali: 34 . Pañca balāni – saddhābalaṃ vīriyabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ paññābalaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 34. 五力(balāni)：信力、精进力、念力、定力、慧力。
entries.english: 34. Five powers: the power of faith, the power of energy, the power of mindfulness, the power of concentration, and the power of wisdom.

entries.pali: 40 . ‘‘Sattadhā tattha saṅgaho’’ti vatvāna puna taṃ dassetuṃ ‘‘saṅkappapassaddhi cā’’ tyādi vuttaṃ . Tattha vīriyaṃ navaṭṭhānaṃ sammappadhānacatukkavīriyiddhipādavīriyindriyavīriyabalasambojjhaṅgasammāvāyāmavasena navakiccattā, sati aṭṭhaṭṭhānā satipaṭṭhānacatukkasatindriyasatibalasatisambojjhaṅgasammāsativasena aṭṭhakiccattā. Samādhi catuṭṭhāno samādhindriyasamādhibalasamādhisambojjhaṅgasammāsamādhivasena catukiccattā, paññā pañcaṭṭhānā vīmaṃsiddhipādapaññindriyapaññābaladhammavicayasambojjhaṅgasammādiṭṭhivasena pañcakiccattā, saddhā dviṭṭhānā saddhindriyasaddhābalavasena dvikiccattā. Eso uttamānaṃ bodhipakkhiyabhāvena visiṭṭhānaṃ sattatiṃsa dhammānaṃ pavaro uttamo vibhāgo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 40. 说了‘彼处有七种摄集’后，为了再次显示彼义，才说了‘思惟与轻安’等。其中，精进有九处，即以四正勤、精进神足、精进根、精进力、精进觉支、正精进的方式，有九种作用；念有八处，即以四念处、念根、念力、念觉支、正念的方式，有八种作用；定有四处，即以定根、定力、定觉支、正定的方式，有四种作用；慧有五处，即以观神足、慧根、慧力、择法觉支、正见的方式，有五种作用；信有二处，即以信根、信力的方式，有两种作用。此是殊胜之三十七菩提分法中，最上等的分别。
entries.english: 40. Having stated, 'There is a sevenfold grouping here,' to further illustrate that, 'intention and tranquility,' etc., is stated. In this context, energy has nine instances: the four right exertions, energy as a basis of spiritual power, the faculty of energy, the power of energy, the enlightenment factor of energy, and right effort—thus having nine functions. Mindfulness has eight instances: the four foundations of mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, and right mindfulness—thus having eight functions. Concentration has four instances: the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and right concentration—thus having four functions. Wisdom has five instances: investigation as a basis of spiritual power, the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, and right view—thus having five functions. Faith has two instances: the faculty of faith and the power of faith—thus having two functions. This is the supreme, excellent classification of the thirty-seven states distinguished by their nature as factors of enlightenment.
